verdict.rationale: Portfolio rollup is a fair axis for a work-management product like monday.com, but the evidence pack never documents a multi-project or portfolio view that aggregates progress. The closest items don't qualify. Custom dashboard widgets are developer building blocks. The 'cross-platform view' claim concerns integration data sync. The 'one dashboard' for agent auditing and AI credit spend is an adjacent feature. Agent-generated status reports and 'spot progress gaps' are agent marketing claims, not a portfolio view.
